subject: Re: Scheduling demo — self‑serve signup follow up / quick qualification
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@brightdata.io>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 13:04:00 -0400
Subject: Demo request — evaluating Redwood for embeddings/search

Hi Ethan,

I signed up for the self-serve trial this morning and am evaluating Redwood for our embeddings + semantic search use case.

Quick context: we run a customer support search layer over product docs and past tickets. Current volume is roughly 400k queries/month but expected to grow to ~1M within 6–9 months. Latency at tail and token cost are pain points for us.

Would love a short demo to see how Redwood handles KV cache, batching, and whether Dedicated/reserved options make sense for our traffic profile. We’re aiming to pilot in Q3, ideally starting a 6–8 week PoC in July.

Available windows next week: Tue/Wed mornings (ET) or Thu after 2pm ET.

Thanks —
Alex
Head of Search, BrightData
alex.j@brightdata.io

----
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@brightdata.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 13:38:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo request — evaluating Redwood for embeddings/search

Hi Alex —

Thanks for signing up and for the context, this is helpful. I’d be happy to run a focused 30-minute demo and cover how caching, batching, and Dedicated capacity can lower per-token cost and improve tail latency. Before we lock a time, a couple quick Qs so I can tailor the session: 

- Primary goal: are you focused on improving end-user search latency, lowering inference cost, or reducing variability for SLOs?
- Typical sequence length for queries and doc chunks (tokens)? e.g., short queries (~10–30 tokens) searching against 1–2k tokens doc chunks, or longer contexts?
- Which models/embedding stacks are you evaluating right now (open-source family, managed models, hybrid)?
- Who do you expect to attend the demo from your side (technical PM, infra lead, security)? I ask because we can include a short slide on Dedicated/Private if security is a concern.

I attached a one‑pager with our deployment options and a short checklist you can share with your team (redwood-one-pager.pdf).

Proposed slots (ET):
- Wed 06/23 09:30–10:00
- Wed 06/23 11:00–11:30
- Thu 06/24 14:30–15:00

If none work, send over a preferred link (Calendly/meeting invite) and I’ll coordinate.

Cheers,
Ethan Park
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.ai

----
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@brightdata.io>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo request — evaluating Redwood for embeddings/search

Ethan —

Thanks for the fast reply and the one‑pager (looks useful). Quick answers inline: 
- Primary goal: reduce tail latency for end users while keeping cost under control — both are important.
- Typical sequences: queries are short (~15 tokens) but we embed doc chunks of ~1,200–2,000 tokens (we chunk longer docs).
- Models: currently testing OpenAI embeddings and a tuned open-source embedding model we host. Interested in Redwood’s catalog/quantization guidance.
- Attendees: me and our infra lead (Priya), maybe product manager. Security isn’t a blocker but we will want to ask about data residency and retention.

Wed 06/23 11:00 works for us. Can we push the time to 11:15 if that helps? Also could you include any cost/throughput examples for a ~1M qpm-month profile?

Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Hey Alex — looping in Marissa from Solutions to help with the PoC planning + demo logistics. I can host on Zoom and will bring a short throughput/cost slide tuned to a 1M qpm‑month projection. 

Ethan — I’ll take the 11:15 slot (Wed 06/23) and send a calendar invite to Alex + Priya. Alex — please let me know Priya’s email and whether you prefer Zoom or Google Meet. Also, if you can drop a small sample doc (anonymized) or a short tokenized example we’ll use that in the demo to make the numbers concrete.

Looking forward —
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
